name: Is a built-in shower niche better than a hanging shower caddy?

mainEntity.name: Is a built-in shower niche better than a hanging shower caddy?

acceptedAnswer.text: A built-in niche is permanently integrated into the wall framing, whereas hanging caddies hang over showerheads or stick to tile with suction cups. Niches eliminate visual clutter, will not rust or slip, and keep bottles secure without consuming usable elbow room inside the shower. The tradeoff is permanence and upfront cost; a built-in niche must be planned during a full shower remodel or retiling project, whereas hanging caddies are inexpensive, temporary fixes that require no wall alterations.
acceptedAnswer.description: A built-in niche provides recessed, permanent storage that saves shower space and eliminates clutter, though it requires installation during a remodel.
